name: Malawi
famous_for: 'The Warm Heart of Africa' for friendly locals, crystal Lake Malawi with 1,000 cichlid fish species, and Mount Mulanje.
tourists: Approx. 1.0M visitors; famous for Lake Malawi snorkeling at Cape Maclear, Liwonde elephant safari, and Nyika plateau.
must_know: Lake Malawi National Park was the world's first freshwater national park and contains more species of fish than any other lake.
fun_fact: The Gule Wamkulu ritual masked dance of the Chewa people is recognized by UNESCO as Masterpiece of Oral and Intangible Heritage.
